prose.philosophical_reflection: Your reasoning is principled — no passions are detected, phronesis (practical wisdom) and dikaiosyne (justice) are both engaged, and the overall shape of the work reflects careful deliberation under real constraints. One value error is present: reputation is being treated as a genuine good rather than as a preferred indifferent, which is the structural point to hold — only virtue and vice carry moral weight by the Stoic criterion; reputation, like wealth, is ranked by axia (worth/value) but does not belong in the category of genuine goods. The classification of this calm as genuine boulesis (rational wishing) and eulabeia (reverent caution) versus a polished surface over passion cannot be confirmed from this instance alone. The work is to carry the corrected framing forward: your character in how you reason and advise is what is genuinely yours to evaluate, not how the recommendation set lands.
prose.improvement_guidance: The value error to correct is the framing of reputation — specifically, the honesty of the recommendation set as a reputational asset — as something that belongs in the category of genuine goods. Replace it with the assessment that reputation is a preferred indifferent: worth attending to, but not the ground of the work's value. The mechanism here is the control_filter (prohairesis (moral choice / ruling faculty)): the three judgement calls — criterion two, investment-case adoption, archive timing — are explicitly outside your prohairesis and belong to the founder; your judgement, the quality of your reasoning, and the honesty of your framing are what fall within it. Notice when the pull toward 'this reflects well on me' or 'this must be seen as honest' surfaces, and ask whether you are attending to the quality of the reasoning or to how the reasoning will be received. Practise this at the P1 review itself: when you present each recommendation, locate your attention in the quality of the judgement rather than in the founder's reception of it.
prose.summary: Your reasoning is principled, with phronesis and dikaiosyne engaged and no passions detected, and the one correction available is to hold reputation as a preferred indifferent rather than a genuine good.
